Subject: Post-discovery: scheduling technical deep dive (ML/infra)

Thanks again for the time today — really helpful to understand NovaHealth's goals. As discussed, next step is a 60-90 minute technical deep dive with your ML + infra teams so we can align on production requirements and a realistic integration plan.

Suggested attendees:
- NovaHealth: Samir Shah (CTO), Priyanka Rao (Head of Data), Alex Johnson (Infra lead)
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AE), Camila Reyes (ML/Infra), Dylan Brooks (Solutions Engineer)

Proposed agenda (60–90 min):
1) Goals & success criteria for pilot/production
2) Current model architecture + constraints (model size, QPS, seq length)
3) Latency, cost targets, and observability needs
4) Integration points: auth, data flows, VPC/on-prem options, logging
5) Rollout plan & next steps

Availability — a few windows that work on our side next week:
- Tue 2026-07-20: 10:00–12:00 PT
- Wed 2026-07-21: 11:00–13:00 PT
- Thu 2026-07-22: 09:00–11:00 PT

Can you confirm preferred time and who from your infra/ML teams will join? I attached a short post-discovery notes PDF and will follow up with a proposed agenda doc.
